scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.db:integration:start: docker compose -p coffee-roasters-integration -f docker-compose.integration.yml up -d --wait postgres-integration
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.test:integration: pnpm db:integration:reset && TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL=postgres://coffee_roasters_integration:coffee_roasters_integration@localhost:54330/coffee_roasters_test pnpm db:migrate:integration && TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://coffee_roasters_integration:coffee_roasters_integration@localhost:54330/coffee_roasters_test vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
